Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded the task based on ambiguous and contradictory data without verifying the specific birthplace of the father. In Step 2, the WebSurfer provided conflicting information: the first search result (Wikipedia) indicated the father was John Bowes, 9th Earl of Strathmore and Kinghorne, who was a Scottish nobleman (implying Scotland), while the second search result (ThePeerage) explicitly stated the father was born in "County Durham, England." The Planner failed to resolve this discrepancy between the Scottish title and the English birthplace. Instead of clarifying the specific birthplace to answer "Which country," the Planner prematurely declared the task complete in Step 3, relying on the Scottish title as a proxy for nationality rather than the explicit birthplace data found in the sources. This matches the error pattern of concluding a task based on inferred information (titles) rather than verified explicit data (birthplace).
